wiring.name: Version 1
wiring.description:
Has multiple states that allow for a quick static or animated display. Use the advanced states with different timing tracks of various speeds to get finer control. Try a timing track at 125ms for a trot and 250ms for the head and tail movements.
There is also a singing face that pairs with a state model called EZ (For Face) which will give you a static singing prop.
If you'd like to make a running prop that sings, use the face and manually stack the advanced state models over / under it to create motion.
